Keep Yourself Safe

2D animated short · 2025

A short film about how casually the internet tells a teenage girl to hurt herself, and about the cheerful industry that turns up afterwards selling her the cure. Written, animated, sound-designed and produced solo, from the first background painting to the final mix, and selected for the Paris Lyon Singapore programme at Annecy 2025.

Role
Writing, animation, sound design, production
Runtime
1 min 30 s, hand-drawn

Lead project · Brand system

A brand for a startup helping families cut harmful screen time and get kids back into hands-on play. Named, drawn and built as a system: one ampersand that reads as an acorn and an animal at once, two sub-brands that fall out of the name itself, and a campaign that puts the blame on the algorithm rather than the child.

Role
Naming, identity, typography, art direction
Type
Gulf Display · Garet
